facts.fact: Mobile money has operated in Congo since 2012, through MTN's Mobile Money Congo and Airtel's Mobile Commerce Congo, with 3.431 million subscribers in 2023 according to the author.
facts.system: Mobile Money Congo and Mobile Commerce Congo

facts.fact: The author says interoperability with conventional banks makes up 36% of mobile money transactions in Congo.
